# MyBCAT (My Business Care Team)

> MyBCAT runs remote answering, scheduling, recall and front desk support for optometry practices of any size, from one location to groups. Coordinators answer calls under the practice's name and book appointments in the practice's own scheduling system.

## Who we serve
- Optometry and ophthalmology practices of any size, from 1 location to 50+: https://mybcat.com/industries/optometry/
- Pages for other specialties (dental, veterinary, dermatology, MedSpa, urgent care, ENT): https://mybcat.com/industries/

## Services
- Medical answering service: live coordinators answer patient calls 24/7 and book appointments in the practice's EHR or PM system: https://mybcat.com/solutions/medical-answering-service/
- Optometry virtual assistant: a dedicated assistant for scheduling, insurance verification, patient recall and EHR work: https://mybcat.com/solutions/optometry-virtual-assistant/
- Front desk outsourcing: remote staff handle calls, appointment confirmations, insurance coordination and scheduling, with business-hours, extended-hours or 24/7 coverage: https://mybcat.com/solutions/front-desk-outsourcing/
- Patient recall: phone, text and email campaigns that bring overdue patients back for care: https://mybcat.com/solutions/patient-recall/
- No-show recovery: same-day calls to reschedule patients who miss appointments: https://mybcat.com/solutions/no-show-recovery/
- Virtual medical assistant: insurance verification, referral coordination and prior authorization processing: https://mybcat.com/solutions/medical-virtual-assistant/
- Virtual medical scribe: remote documentation support for clinical encounters: https://mybcat.com/solutions/virtual-medical-scribe/
- EHR and PM system integrations: https://mybcat.com/solutions/integrations/
- Practice finances: a remote team keeps the schedule full and lowers front-desk labor cost; we manage the team and do not do tax work at this time: https://mybcat.com/optometry-practice-finances/

## Pricing
- Plans start at $10/hr: https://mybcat.com/pricing/
